script_text: Stop! Aries, the fiery stars are screaming at you right now. Mars is drilling into your 9th House of Travel, forming a fierce square to Saturn in your 10th House of Career. This clash demands you balance your wanderlust with professional duties. In love, Venus brushes shoulders with Neptune in your 7th House, painting your relationships with ethereal charm. A message from someone special could spark unexpected chemistry. Your 10th House grinds against Mars’ 9th House push, so your ambitions hit roadblocks. Patience pays—your big break comes after careful planning, not rash moves. Avoid signing anything today; a hidden clause could trap you. But a mentor’s advice brings clarity. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
